generator.description: Raw sextant readings of the Moon, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, the Sun and six stars from Skyfield's sky on a spherical and on the WGS84 Earth, with the geocentric altitude a correct reduction must return.

frame.definition: Apparent geocentric of date (CONVENTIONS section 7): true equator and equinox of date.
excludes: diurnal aberration (this is a geocentric frame; the observer is not moving in it)
topocentric parallax (CONVENTIONS section 5 applies it as an altitude correction)
frame.gha_sign: west-positive, [0, 360), as tabulated in the Nautical Almanac
includes: precession and nutation to the true equator and equinox of date (Skyfield's IAU 2000A/2006 model)
relativistic light deflection by the Sun
stellar proper motion and annual parallax from the Hipparcos catalogue (stars)

generator.horizontal_parallax: Moon asin(6378.14 km / geometric distance); planets asin(6378.137 km / light-time distance); Sun 8.794 arcsec at 1 au
generator.never_a_runtime_dependency: Generated by tools/reference/ (Python + Skyfield). CONVENTIONS section 11: never regenerate a fixture from Rust output.

refraction.applied_as: true -> apparent by solving H - R(H) = h for the apparent altitude H
refraction.formula: CONVENTIONS section 5 step 3 (Bennett 1982), common.py:bennett_refraction_arcmin, coded from the text
refraction.skyfield_refraction: not used (it differs from CONVENTIONS by 0.07 % of the refraction)

generator.semidiameters: Moon asin(0.2725076 x 6378.14 km / d); Sun 959.63 arcsec at 1 au; planets asin(IAU 2015 equatorial radius / d); topocentric d for the sights, geocentric d for the supplied directions
generator.stars: Hipparcos with SIMBAD radial velocities and rigorous space motion; Rigil Kentaurus (alpha Cen A) on its ORB6 orbit (common.build_stars)

timescale.clock: the app's clock (CONVENTIONS 15.2): UTC 1972-01-01 .. 2035-12-31, UT (= UT1) outside; clock_time() turns a clock instant into TT and UT1
timescale.delta_t_source: SkyFix Lab's own Delta T (crates/skyfix-core/src/deltat/data.rs): Stephenson, Morrison & Hohenkerk 2016/2020 splines, the IERS weekly table 1973 on, the long-term parabola beyond, joined as Skyfield 1.55 joins them
timescale.dut1_zero: gha_deg_dut1_zero columns use dut1_zero_timescale(): UT1 = UTC on the UTC scale (the Nautical Almanac's and USNO's convention), the model's UT1 outside

generator.tolerance_justification: Each case carries three numbers. `chain_ho_deg` is the amended CONVENTIONS section 5 chain transcribed in Python from the text: the Rust chain must reproduce it to 1e-6 arcmin (arithmetic). `expected_ho_deg` is the geocentric altitude at the site from DE440s (CONVENTIONS section 3): on the `sphere` Earth the chain lands within 0.01 arcmin of it, the residual being the 0.3-arcsec diurnal aberration Skyfield applies and the project does not. On the `wgs84` Earth the residual is what the spherical Earth of CONVENTIONS section 1 leaves out, recorded per body class in `worst_chain_minus_expected_arcmin`; the Rust test holds each case to its class's recorded worst plus 0.002 arcmin.
generator.ut1: Every instant is on the app's clock with UT1 = UTC on the UTC scale (common.load_timescale(dut1_zero=True); the clock is UT1 after 2035), so GHA and the horizon frame carry DUT1 = 0 (CONVENTIONS section 6).
generator.venus: centre of light: moved toward the Sun by 0.44 (1 - cos i) SD (the Nautical Almanac convention, skyfix_ephemeris::sights)
